title: Unità 4 · Quando ero piccolo/a
question: What was I like as a child, and what did I do?
workingOn: describing my childhood and a place I visited
canDo: I can describe what I did as a child.
I can say my favorite things to do growing up.
I can understand short written passages about past events.
I can describe a place I visited.
culture: Italian kids play nascondino (hide-and-seek) and campana (hopscotch) in courtyards, piazzas and parks. Because many parents work, i nonni often pick children up from school, cook lunch and watch them in the afternoon. For many Italians, childhood memories are full of their grandparents.

words: I had / I used to have

grammar.head: Imperfetto = how things were and what I used to do: -vo, -vi, -va, -vamo, -vate, -vano
tricks: Imperfetto = used to / was …ing: giocavo = I used to play.
-are verbs: cut -re, add -vo, -vi, -va: giocare → giocavo, abitare → abitavo.
essere is irregular: ero, eri, era. Quando ero piccolo/a = When I was little.
One finished event → passato prossimo: Ho visitato Roma. A habit or a description → imperfetto: Roma era bella.

sentences: Quando ero piccola, abitavo a Napoli.
When I was little, I lived in Naples.
Da piccolo avevo un cane bianco.
As a kid I had a white dog.
Giocavo a nascondino con i miei cugini.
I used to play hide-and-seek with my cousins.
Mia sorella giocava sempre con la bambola.
My sister always played with her doll.
Il mio giocattolo preferito era il pallone.
My favorite toy was the ball.
I nonni abitavano vicino a noi.
My grandparents lived near us.
Andavamo al parco giochi la domenica.
We used to go to the playground on Sundays.
La mia maestra era molto simpatica.
My teacher was very nice.
Nel mio quartiere c'era un grande parco.
There was a big park in my neighborhood.
Eravate felici da piccoli?
Were you all happy as kids?
L'anno scorso ho visitato Roma.
Last year I visited Rome.
Roma era bellissima!
Rome was beautiful!

trick: Even essere ends in -o for io: ero.

forms.why: lei → era. La maestra era simpatica.
trick: ero, eri, era: o, i, a.
andare is regular in the imperfetto: anda + vamo.

forms.why: One finished visit → passato prossimo: ho visitato.
trick: A habit = visitavo. One visit = ho visitato.
giochi (now) needs h; giocavi (then) does not.

fill.why: Quando ero piccola = When I was little.

read.title: Da piccola a Napoli
passage: Quando ero piccola, abitavo a Napoli con la mia famiglia.
When I was little, I lived in Naples with my family.
I nonni abitavano vicino a noi.
Ogni pomeriggio la nonna preparava la merenda.
Every afternoon Grandma made the afternoon snack.
Io e mio cugino giocavamo a campana nel cortile.
My cousin and I played hopscotch in the courtyard.
L'estate scorsa ho visitato Napoli di nuovo: era bellissima!
Last summer I visited Naples again: it was beautiful!

questions.why: Quando ero piccola, abitavo a Napoli.
Ogni pomeriggio la nonna preparava la merenda.

questions.q: Quando ha visitato Napoli di nuovo?
questions.why: L'estate scorsa ho visitato Napoli di nuovo.

listen.en: Where did you live when you were five?

listen.q: Qual era il tuo gioco preferito?

lines: Nonna, a che cosa giocavi da piccola?
Grandma, what did you play when you were little?
I played hopscotch in the courtyard!
And did you have a doll?
Sì, ma il mio gioco preferito era il nascondino.
Yes, but my favorite game was hide-and-seek.
Of course! Like in the old days!

prompts: A che cosa giocavi da piccolo/a?

finish: Now I know how to describe my childhood and a place I visited!

idiom.ex: Oggi giochiamo a nascondino, come ai vecchi tempi!
idiom.exEn: Today we're playing hide-and-seek, like in the old days!
idiom.note: Said when you do something the way you used to, often with a little nostalgia.

flags: First contact with the imperfetto: limited to essere, avere and regular -are verbs (giocare, abitare, andare). andare is regular in the imperfetto (andavo), so it is used outside the chart.
Passato prossimo vs imperfetto: only the basic contrast (one finished event vs habit / description) in one trick and one forms item. No full contrast drill.
c'era (there was) appears once (Nel mio quartiere c'era un grande parco) as a chunk; not taught as a form.

piccolo/a and da piccolo/a use a slash in titles, chips and parla starters; the listen questions avoid the slash (Dove abitavi a cinque anni?) so text-to-speech reads cleanly. Check how TTS reads the parla prompt A che cosa giocavi da piccolo/a?
Reading: bellissima (superlative -issimo) and preparava (preparare) are glossed or transparent.
il gioco (game) vs il giocattolo (toy) are both listed so students don't confuse them.
Vicino a noi and l'estate scorsa are glossed / transparent chunks; seasons come from Page 2.
